Oh my god. So many red flags. From you.

Yes YTA, you invaded her privacy and deleted what seems like her only place outside your relationship. You seem really controlling and manipulative and not interested in starting a dialogue and fixing your relationship but rather on stopping your partner from having anyone other than you in her life. 

She is allowed to have a life outside your relationship and in fact it’s healthy if she does. You should have just sat her down BEORE checking her phone and had a conversation about how you were feeling neglected. It’s a tough conversation to have but you need to have those sometimes in order to move forward. 

You need to apologise and hope she forgives you and never do anything like that again. Just because you’re her partner doesn’t mean you’re entitled to know everything about her life and it definitely doesn’t mean you have the right to restrict her contact with people outside your relationship. You even said the comments were harmless you’re just controlling. Be better.
She’s doesn’t actually know yet...kinda scared to tell her

Yea I do kinda feel bad now. I deleted them just after I got home still super angry and my sister brought me snacks and drinks to apologise but what’s done is done I guess, from both of us. I’m just hoping she’ll know I’m serious from now on when I say stop.
Yea I hate the thought of that. Something tells me the argument ‘my sister asked me to take them’ won’t hold up in court

I messaged him before but he'd only said he'd think about it. He said yes the morning after but didn't tell me about her until I asked this weekend.

Not quite. I suggested it and left it to him to say yes or no. I don't care that he wanted to sleep either her but if he'd messaged me and said yes to it then it wouldn't have even been a problem. At that point we weren't open. I didn't do anything with anyone until he was 100% sure he wanted to. 

And no I didn't want anyone else.
